description: Gnanawathie Edirisinghe v. Ministry of Lands and Lands Development and Others Gnanawathie Edirisinghe v. Ministry of Lands and Lands Development and Others View More before Hon. S. Sriskandarajah, J.
parties: Gnanawathie Edirisinghe v. Ministry of Lands and Lands Development and Others Gnanawathie Edirisinghe v. Ministry of Lands and Lands Development and Others View More
keywords: Petitioner permitted property as temporary access road to housing scheme for flood victims; challenged alternative access route and lack of public purpose for acquisition; urgency under Section 38(a) of the Land Acquisition Act. Held - Petitioner had not alleged mala fides against the acquisition; delay in acquisition; failure to prove no urgency. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
